01 APPLIED ML · SG ANALYTICS

Bayesian Hierarchical Prediction

I built models that connect school, subregion, and global patterns to estimate enquiry-level probabilities and their uncertainty.

PyMCBayesian modellingCalibration
Inside the project +

Problem

How can related schools inform individual predictions while preserving local differences?

My contribution

I built hierarchical classification models with posterior probabilities and highest-density intervals to express uncertainty. I used calibration and feature reduction, including VIF, information value, mutual information, and PhiK.

Output

Enquiry-level probability estimates and uncertainty intervals that draw on school, subregion, and global patterns.

Professional project · SG Analytics

FROM DEMAND TO DECISIONS
Forecast & uncertainty · schematic
02 FORECASTING · SG ANALYTICS

Demand Forecasting & Workforce Optimisation

I developed a call-centre planning pipeline that translates demand forecasts into staffing estimates, rosters, and coverage views.

Prophet / ARIMAErlang-COR-Tools
Inside the project +

Problem

How do forecast call volumes translate into staffing requirements and workable rosters?

My contribution

I developed demand forecasts with Prophet and ARIMA, simulated call volumes with Poisson models, and used Erlang-C queueing to estimate staffing needs. I optimised rosters with OR-Tools CP-SAT.

Output

Forecast demand, staffing estimates, rosters, and coverage views to assess service-level trade-offs.

Professional project · SG Analytics

03 AI SYSTEMS · SG ANALYTICS

Enterprise Presentation Automation

I contributed to a system for repeated presentation updates: extracting slide content, planning changes, and regenerating decks.

PythonStreamlitLLM orchestration
Inside the project +

Problem

How can repeated updates to business presentations become a structured, automatable workflow?

My contribution

I contributed to the content-to-deck workflow: extracting PowerPoint content into JSON, planning slide-level updates, and regenerating decks. The system uses Python, Streamlit, PowerPoint automation, and LLM/agent orchestration.

Output

Regenerated presentation decks produced through a connected extraction, planning, and update workflow.
